facts.business: Caprihans India Limited manufactures pharmaceutical packaging solutions, specializing in PVC, PVDC, and multi-layer blister films for solid oral dosage packaging, serving domestic and global pharmaceutical customers.

capacity_or_capex.item: Flexible PVC manufacturing facility at Taloja
capacity_or_capex.timeline: completion targeted for the ensuing financial period

guidance_or_targets.statement: Upon full commissioning, this facility is expected to contribute meaningfully to the Company's manufacturing capacity and market presence in the Flexible PVC segment.

auditor.name: M/s Patki & Soman, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of matter regarding arrangement with Bilcare Limited for repayment of Public Fixed Deposit liability of Rs 3.92 Crores outstanding as on 31st March 2026, earmarked in PFD Repayment account. Opinion not modified.

key_risks: High input and logistics costs due to geopolitical conflicts (Ukraine-Russia war, Gulf instability) leading to lower margins
Dependence on regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions (EU, US FDA, China FDA, WHO GMP)
Transition to eco-friendly materials and newer laminates (PET, PE, proprietary coatings) gaining traction
Pre-operative expenses impacting short-term profitability at new Taloja facility
facts.related_party_note: Arrangement and agreement with Bilcare Limited regarding repayment of principal and interest on Public Fixed Deposit (PFD) liability taken over by the Company, carrying amount of Rs 109.60 Crores as at 27th March 2023 per Slump Sale Agreement. Statutory compliances related to PFD under Companies Act, 2013 is responsibility of Bilcare. Outstanding amount including interest is Rs 3.92 Crores as on 31st March 2026, earmarked and maintained with PFD Repayment account.
